body:
Author-side note from SKULL (not a review).

**For the reviewer: this changes posted motion.** A whole-model 3D Pocket or Multi-Axis Rough now clears the stock margin out to the stock outline. Before, it stopped about one tool radius past the part's silhouette.

**Not exercised here:**
- a fixture or clamp standing in the newly cleared margin (the verify fixture law should flag it, but no test proves that);
- the ignored heavy lanes (`pocket3d_hsm`'s per-OS move counts, `stock_engine_agreement`), which may shift.

**Base:** after #1772 merges, this branch takes `origin/main` and is re-gated.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 752d6c13c1216c3b83da9c7c48823254d6d69b6e -->
Code review: clean. The branch has a merge conflict with main.

This is a safety review. The change increases the area of posted cutting motion.

Checks that passed:
- The stock outline reaches both the 3D Pocket and Multi-Axis Rough generators.
- Picked regions and boundary controls keep their specified area.
- Other parts remain subject to the solid check. Fixture checks still run after path generation.
- The tilted whole-model case gives a named refusal.
- I read each changed test assertion. No golden files changed. The bore-floor test now permits cuts below the part only outside its footprint. It keeps the bore-floor check and the check for no warnings.
- No UI, dependency, build script, or workflow files changed.

Local build and test results:
The trial merge used upstream/main at e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90. It failed in crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs. I did not resolve that code conflict. I cancelled the trial merge and ran these checks on the PR head in the separate review worktree. These results do not prove the combined tree with current main.

- Test build: passed for pocket3d_open_side, operations, level_links, and shared_face_bodies.
- level_links: 7 passed.
- operations: 120 passed; 6 ignored.
- pocket3d_open_side: 5 passed.
- shared_face_bodies: 5 passed; 1 ignored.
- Tilted-refusal unit test: 1 passed.
- area_controls: 13 passed.
- keep_law: 8 passed.
- neighbour_law: 5 passed.
- pocket3d_hsm: 1 passed; 1 ignored.
- Clippy: passed for camcraft-motion and camcraft-app, all targets, with warnings denied.

I repeated two mutation checks:
1. Disable the stock union. The far-stock test failed with:
   ```text
   the stock past the silhouette keeps Z 32.000 at (34.90, -34.90); the floor is Z 20
   ```
   I restored the file. The same test passed.
2. Disable the tilted refusal. The unit test failed at its expected-error check:
   ```text
   a tilted whole model refuses: Region { ... }
   ```
   I restored the file. The same test passed.
Both source files matched their original bytes after restoration.

Code changes requested: none.

Before merge: resolve the conflict at crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs:164 when this PR reaches its merge turn. The PR expects the imported sample to generate a path. Main expects a named refusal. Keep the intended new test and run the affected checks on the combined tree. The conflicts label applies until this is done.

Coverage limits: I did not run the ignored heavy lanes or stock_engine_agreement. No test in this PR puts a clamp in the newly cleared stock margin. A small test for that case would improve coverage of this safety boundary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Author-side fix stopped under the requested conflict rule. No changes were pushed.

The latest review requests only a merge-conflict resolution and checks on the combined tree. It requests no code changes.

Merging upstream/main at fe1a94c7778279fecbb2f1135d64e046dd3b1dba conflicts in crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs:164-183. Both sides change the same test logic for the as-imported sample's R1 operation. The PR expects generation to succeed. Main requires generation to fail with “nothing to cut: the open area is too narrow for the 6 mm tool and 0 mm stock to leave at every level”. Keeping both would assert opposite outcomes for the same operation. Choosing the PR side would remove main's refusal assertion.

The instruction says to stop when both sides changed the same logic or a safety rule could be lost. I aborted the merge. The head remains 752d6c13c1216c3b83da9c7c48823254d6d69b6e. No mutation checks, gate, or clippy ran because there is no resolved combined tree. This needs a decision about the intended outcome before a re-review can proceed.

This PR is a draft again. Reason: a merge-time refresh starts now. The parent PR #1772 merged to main as `c0e502d18`. The merge of `origin/main` into this branch has a conflict in `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs`, and the resolution needs hand edits. A refresh with hand edits is new work, thus the PR stays a draft until its delta review.

Merge-time refresh: main (`c0e502d18`, with #1772) is merged into this branch. The new head is `2d7a638f5`. There is no rebase and no force-push. The PR stays a draft for its delta review.

Hand-edited files:
- `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_open_side.rs`: the two sides added tests at the same place. This PR adds `stock_far_past_the_silhouette_is_cleared_to_the_stock_outline` and `no_3d_pocket_kind_carries_a_tilt`. Main adds `added_part_blocks_live_post` and its two `*_post_refuses_a_part_added_after_clean_generation_on_rotated_stock` tests. All are kept. No assertion changed.

Files that merged without a conflict:
- `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs` and `docs/decisions/1749-pocket3d-open-side.md` are equal to main. Main's version of `the_sample_as_imported_roughs_the_3d_pocket_beside_its_silhouette` (the blocking `shank_hit` / `rapid_in_stock` findings, and the clean verify with the long-flute tool) passes with this PR's generator change.

Check of the "verify is clean" claim: a scratch test ran `GenerateOperation` and `posting::post_setup` on the 70 mm far-stock world of `stock_far_past_the_silhouette_is_cleared_to_the_stock_outline`. The result: status `Ok`, 0 warnings, the post writes an NC file. The claim in the body and in the decision file is true. The scratch test is removed. No text change is necessary.

Tests on the merged tree (debug):
- camcraft-app `pocket3d_open_side`: 7 passed.
- camcraft-app `shared_face_bodies`: 5 passed, 1 ignored.
- camcraft-app `keep_law`: 8 passed.
- camcraft-app `neighbour_law`: 6 passed.
- camcraft-app `operations`: 120 passed, 6 ignored.
- camcraft-app `level_links`: 7 passed.
- camcraft-app `area_controls`: 13 passed.
- camcraft-app `pocket3d_hsm`: 1 passed, 1 ignored.
- camcraft-app `whole_model_pocket`: 5 passed, 1 ignored.
- camcraft-app lib `open_side`: 1 passed.
- camcraft-motion `level_links` 12 passed, `machining3d` 23 passed, `pocket3d_hsm` 3 passed (1 ignored), `pocket_refusal` 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not run: the ignored heavy lanes (`pocket3d_hsm` move counts, `stock_engine_agreement`), the batch tier, the ui suites.

Delta class: `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 1780 --reviewed 752d6c13c` gives DELTA (hand-resolved: `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_open_side.rs`). The next step is a delta review of `git show --remerge-diff 2d7a638f5`. Main moved after the refresh (#1818, #1823). `git merge-tree` shows that the head merges cleanly with the current main, and GitHub reports MERGEABLE. Thus the `conflicts` label is removed.

The last `pr-reviewer` marker (on `752d6c13c`) is from the author account. An independent full review of this PR is still necessary before it merges.

Merge batch. Class: DELTA. The refresh of head `2d7a638f5` has one hand resolution in `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_open_side.rs`. This merge relies on the clean full independent review https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/1780#pullrequestreview-5910489035. The follow-up issues are #1850, #1851 and #1852.
